page.overview:
What is Zacian?

When it is holding a Rusted Sword in battle it turns into its Crowned Sword form, which is a / type.

Zacian's 'Hero of many battles' form resembles a quadrupedal, yellow-eyed, azure and white wolf with a coral pink nose and lower jaw, small coral pink wing blade-like fur, long matching colored braid-like fur and a coral pink tail in a triangle shape. Zacian has multiple scars and scratches all over its svelte body and its left ear is cut half clean off, likely a result of injuries it suffered from battles. Its azure fur also looks somewhat mussed in places.

In its Crowned Sword form, Zacian wears a gold armor with wing-like plates on its front legs, smaller plates on its hind legs, and a crown-like helmet that covers up the broken ear, the coral pink fur bangs become thicker and more slender, and the azure fur is cleaner. In this form, Zacian carries a golden sword with azure and coral pink colored gems on its mouth.

Shiny Zacian is cyan, as its name suggests.
